content.comment_body: Hello, I installed the [product_name] demo version to learn about it and am considering purchasing one for myself. Any guidance on implementing this logic with block-based programming would be appreciated. Any help is welcome.
Hello [user_name], Check the attached file for a possible solution. Another approach for handling two commands with one button can be found under 'Double tap button'. Kind regards, [user_name]
Thank you! It's working as expected.
Hi, I created this program for another situation, but it might be helpful to you.
